text:
ANDY SAPUTRA
Phone: +6281995247372 | Email: andychensaputra@gmail.com | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/andy-saputra-586b22247 | Website: andylabs.site | Location: Jakarta Barat

SUMMARY
Computer Science student focused on Full-Stack Development with hands-on internship experience building web applications across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases. Strong foundation in software development with experience across multiple languages and frameworks. Comfortable translating requirements into functional, maintainable, and user-focused solutions, plus additional exposure to AI, machine learning, deep learning, and LLM integration.

EDUCATION
Binus University - Alam Sutera, July 2023 - February 2027 (Expected). Bachelor's Degree in Informatics Engineering - System Intelligence. GPA: 3.77/4.00.
- Thesis: Multi-Agent System with Hybrid Approach (NLU, Fuzzy Logic, and LLM) for Social Engineering Simulation in the "Silent Terror" Strategy Game.
- Relevant coursework: Software Engineering, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structure and Algorithm Programming, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing.
- Leadership & activities: Advisor and former activist in Binus TV Club, former Freshman Leader.
SMAS Pelita Utama - Batam, July 2020 - April 2023. President of the Student Representative Council (MPK) and project director of the school's main events. Core learning: Science.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Polytron - Application Developer Intern (Node.js, Express.js, SQL, API, Docker, LLM). Contributed to the development and maintenance of internal web applications supporting employee services and operational processes.
- Developed full-stack features across frontend, backend, APIs, and database layers, including authentication, session management, responsive interfaces, and real-time notifications to support internal workflows.
- Integrated AI capabilities, including NLP and LLM integration, while supporting Docker-based development environments to improve functionality, maintainability, and deployment consistency.
Qreed AI - Full-Stack Developer (Freelance) (Express.js, React.js, Next.js, Sentry, Docker). Develops and maintains Qreed AI, translating client requirements into production-ready features and ongoing improvements.
- Developed full-stack features and application pages across frontend, backend, and APIs using React/Next.js and Node.js/Express.
- Implemented application monitoring and issue tracking while working with Docker-based environments to improve debugging, development consistency, and long-term maintainability.

SELECTED PROJECTS (more at andylabs.site)
- Silent Terror - Thesis project (Angular, Python, SQL, Docker, SVM, Fuzzy Logic, LLM). https://github.com/Andysaputra1/GamesSilentTerror
- My Invitation - Personal project (Node.js). https://www.myinvitation.cards. Digital wedding-invitation platform with themed collections, package previews, and consultation flows.
- Reservasi ID - Personal project (React.js, SQL). https://reservasi-id.andylabs.site. Web-based ferry ticket platform centralizing routes, schedules, and booking information.
- AI Trainer - Personal project (Python, TensorFlow/Keras, MediaPipe Pose, FastAPI, React). https://github.com/Andysaputra1/deeplearning. Exercise-quality assessment from pose-derived features and autoencoder reconstruction error.
- SkolioCheck - University project (Python/Flask, TensorFlow/Keras, VGG16). https://github.com/Andysaputra1/Scoliovis. VGG16-based scoliosis classification prototype from X-ray images.

PERSONAL EXPERIENCE
- Freshmen Leader - Alam Sutera, August 2025 - September 2025. Guided first-year students through Binusian values, academic transition, and campus engagement.
- BINUS TV Club - Alam Sutera, August 2023 - December 2025. Former core member and Technical Advisor (Core Development: PSA, Media Journey, Glimpse of BINUSTV Club, Buram EXPO, LDKA) and Technical Coordinator (Buram Expo).

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C
Frontend & backend: HTML, CSS, React.js, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask
Database, APIs & tools: MySQL, SQL, RESTful APIs, Docker, Git
Artificial intelligence: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLM Integration, OpenAI API, Prompt Engineering

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Soft skills: strong leadership, teamwork, and communication, with an adaptable and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving and time management.
Achievement: 2nd Place - SIM Business Plan Competition, Batam (2022)
Languages: Indonesian, English, Mandarin (Basic), Teochew
